synthesizedFacts.fact: Hyperpigmentation is caused by an excess production of melanin, which can be triggered by sun exposure, hormonal changes, medications, and skin injuries.
Common types of hyperpigmentation include age spots, melasma, and post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.
Sun protection is crucial in managing hyperpigmentation, including the use of sunscreen with SPF greater than 45.
Topical treatments for hyperpigmentation include hydroquinone, vitamin C, azelaic acid, and tretinoin.
Hyperpigmentation can be emotionally distressing and impact self-esteem.
